description.value: The Logan Lake Recreation Centre is the community hub of this small Thompson-Nicola town, housing an ice arena, curling rink, and an 800-square-foot fitness room operated by the LIFT Society with free weights, universal machines, and cardio equipment. It sits in the centre of town on Chartrand Avenue, a short walk from the downtown commercial area. The surrounding area features a trail network that includes purpose-built mountain bike trails, making Logan Lake a potential stop for cycling-focused visitors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the Recreation Centre is open and operating at 31 Chartrand Avenue, Logan Lake, with a fitness room, ice arena, and curling rink — a legitimate public facility. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, showers, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears in the fetched content, so those fields remain null. The trails page confirms mountain biking exists in the area, supporting relevance to cycling tourists, but the core amenity evidence for cyclists is unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; address (31 Chartrand Avenue) and Recreation Centre phone (250-523-6711) sourced from website only.

OSM opening_hours tag conflicts with website — website states open 7 days/week from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m. effective October 1, 2025; OSM shows Tu-Th 11:00-23:00 / Fr-Mo 08:00-23:00. Website is more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The facility is a legitimate public recreation centre in a cycling-relevant community, but none of the required criteria (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) can be confirmed from available evidence. A direct visit or phone inquiry to 250-523-6711 would likely confirm washrooms and water at minimum.
enrichment_extras.notes: The fitness room is operated by a separate society (LIFT) at loganlakelift24@gmail.com. The municipal campground nearby may be a more cyclist-relevant listing to cross-reference.

wow_evidence: Arena, curling rink, and small fitness room; standard rec band in a trail-rich town.
